scope: Read-only inspection of the local ChessPairings web pairing path; no production request, database mutation or deployment.

observations.detail: The selectable engine map does not contain OpenPairingPHP.
An unknown engine key defaults to the legacy bbp port instead of failing closed.
The synchronous path deletes current-round rows and changes derived state before pairing is complete.
A first-round random initial colour is drawn during TRF generation and is not proven persisted before retry.
Missing/short pair lines can be skipped and complete eligible-player accounting is not enforced by the parser.
Game, history and point writes are not wrapped in the required pairing transaction.
The asynchronous state record lacks a canonical input hash, revision and candidate identity.
Completion does not compare current tournament state with the submitted snapshot before writes.
Repeat, colour and unpaired-player findings are warnings rather than a FIDE-mode commit gate.
A revision counter exists in the separate desktop sync model and can inform, but not substitute for, the pairing transaction boundary.
